## Profile
Researcher with a master's degree in psychology from Universitas Padjadjaran and experience in quantitative and qualitative social research. Skilled in survey methodology, psychometrics, statistical analysis, and evidence-based research across academic and field settings. Experienced in adapting and validating psychological instruments, designing research protocols, analysing complex datasets, and producing scientific reports to support research and policy development. Interested in sustainability, environmental behaviour, public policy, and social development.
